regions.today: Today will be dry and sunny. Highest temperatures of 22 to 26 degrees, a little cooler near the east coast due to a light to moderate east to northeast breeze.
regions.tonight: Tonight will be dry and warm with clear spells. Lowest temperatures of 14 to 19 degrees with a light to moderate east to northeast breeze.
regions.tomorrow: Tomorrow will be dry and sunny. It will be very warm or hot in most places with temperatures reaching 24 to 29 degrees, but a little cooler near the east coast as a light to moderate easterly breeze continues.
